nodes.name: NiO Target Preparation
nodes.procedure: The NiO target was made from NiO powder (99.998%, Alfa Aesar) by pelletizing and sintering in air at 1,100°C for 12 h.
nodes.source_text: The NiO target was made from NiO powder (99.998%, Alfa Aesar) by pelletizing and sintering in air at 1,100°C for 12 h.

nodes.name: NiO Thin Film PLD
nodes.procedure: NiO thin films were epitaxially grown on Nb:STO(001) substrates by PLD with a 248 nm KrF excimer from NiO target at the oxygen partial pressure of 10 mTorr. During the growth of NiO, the laser repetition rate and energy density, and the substrate temperature were set as 5 Hz, 1.2 J cm⁻² and 600°C, respectively.
nodes.source_text: NiO and Ni/NiO VAN thin films were epitaxially grown on Nb:STO(001) substrates by PLD... at the oxygen partial pressure of 10 and 0.01 mTorr, respectively.

nodes.name: Ni/NiO VAN PLD
nodes.procedure: Ni/NiO VAN thin films were epitaxially grown on Nb:STO(001) substrates by PLD with a 248 nm KrF excimer from NiO target at the oxygen partial pressure of 0.01 mTorr. To realize the growth of two phases, the PLD growth was conducted at a low oxygen partial pressure of 0.1 mTorr. Similar to the growth process of other self-assembled nanocomposites, the growth of Ni/NiO VAN may go through a three-stage self-decomposition mechanism. In the first stage, NiO adatoms vaporized from NiO target nucleate on the Nb:STO substrate. During the deposition process, a low oxygen pressure triggers the phase segregation of Ni from NiO to form ultra-fine Ni clusters. Next, thermal energy facilitates the coalescence of Ni clusters, forming Ni nanodomains. In the third stage, the phase segregation is stabilized, leading to a vertically aligned heterostructure.

nodes.name: Ni Thin Film Sputtering
nodes.procedure: Ni thin films on Nb:STO(001) substrates were synthesized via magnetron sputtering with a thickness of ~50 nm. Sputtering was performed at an RF power of 200 W and the Ar pressure of 3.8 mTorr for direct deposition from a Ni target.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p XPS shows features of both NiO (855-858 eV) and metallic Ni (853.0 eV) in Ni/NiO VAN; O 1s deconvolution shows 35.4% defective oxygen (Vo) indicating abundant oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S3 shows the O 1s spectra of Ni/NiO VAN, NiO and Ni... The percentage of Vo shows a high value (35.4%) for the Ni/NiO VAN, proving the existence of abundant oxygen vacancies in the Ni/NiO VAN.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni-L2,3 and O-K edge EELS across Ni/NiO interface regions show changes indicating oxygen vacancies and unsaturated coordinated Ni atoms at interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Comparing the fine structures of Ni-L edges in the three regions... These changes suggest the presence of unsaturated coordinated Ni atoms at the Ni/NiO interface... These results can be assigned to the breaking of long-range order and further indicate the presence of oxygen vacancies at the Ni/NiO interface.

nodes.characterization_summary: O 1s NAP-XPS shows three-fold increase in OHads surface concentration (~50%) for Ni/NiO VAN vs. NiO (15-25%) under water vapor, indicating enhanced water dissociation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 4a shows photoelectron spectra of Ni/NiO VAN and NiO in the O 1s region under vacuum and 0.6 mbar water vapour pressure... The percentage of OHads content increases dramatically up to ~50% for Ni/NiO VAN.

nodes.characterization_summary: CV measurements show double layer capacitance Cdl of 46.8 μF cm⁻² for Ni/NiO VAN, 17.3 μF cm⁻² for Ni, and 25.6 μF cm⁻² for NiO.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure S8, the Ni/NiO VAN shows the highest Cdl value (46.8 μF cm⁻²) compared with Ni (17.3 μF cm⁻²) and NiO (25.6 μF cm⁻²)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Reciprocal space maps near Nb:STO (113) reflection show expanded unit cell volume for NiO in Ni/NiO VAN compared to pure NiO, indicating oxygen vacancies at interface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Reciprocal space maps (RSMs) of NiO and Ni/NiO VAN near the (113) reflection of Nb:STO were measured... the unit cell volume of NiO in Ni/NiO VAN is larger than that of pure NiO.
